questions.scenario: A support chatbot is accurate on common FAQs but fails when customers phrase the same intent differently. The system is used by an internal enterprise assistant.
questions.question: Which engineering change most directly improves robustness?

options.text: Replace it with a fixed FAQ page
Evaluate diverse paraphrases and improve intent/data coverage

questions.explanation: Robustness should be evaluated across varied phrasings and the training or evaluation coverage improved. Temperature does not solve an intent-coverage problem.
questions.skill: Applied AI reasoning and engineering decision-making

questions.scenario: A team claims its rule-based tax calculator cannot be AI because it does not learn from data. The system is used by a logistics company.
questions.question: Which statement is most accurate?

options.text: Only neural networks can be AI
AI can include non-learning approaches such as rule-based reasoning
AI always requires a training dataset

questions.explanation: AI is a broad field and can include symbolic or rule-based approaches; machine learning is one approach within AI.
questions.skill: Applied AI reasoning and engineering decision-making

questions.scenario: A fraud model has 99.8% training accuracy but 71% validation accuracy. The system is used by a SaaS product with thousands of customers.
questions.question: What is the strongest initial diagnosis?
questions.explanation: The large training-validation gap is a classic signal of overfitting and poor generalization.
questions.skill: Applied AI reasoning and engineering decision-making

questions.scenario: A model performs poorly on both training and validation data. The system is used by a cloud operations team.
questions.question: Which situation is most consistent with this result?
questions.explanation: Poor performance on both training and validation data suggests the model has not captured enough useful structure.
questions.skill: Applied AI reasoning and engineering decision-making

questions.scenario: An LLM must classify support tickets into five fixed categories and return machine-readable output. The system is used by a manufacturing company.
questions.question: Which prompt design is most appropriate?

options.text: Provide category definitions and require a strict JSON schema

questions.explanation: Clear labels plus a constrained output schema reduce ambiguity and simplify downstream parsing.
questions.skill: Applied AI reasoning and engineering decision-making

questions.scenario: A developer writes one enormous prompt containing research, planning, validation and formatting instructions. The system is used by a travel application.

options.text: Decompose the workflow into explicit stages where appropriate
